scope.limits: Static screenshots and supplied after reports only; no accessibility or interactive behavior claim.

findings.evidence: hud-before.png loses WORLD · topology and both help lines into the dark panel; hud-after.png makes all three readable without a visible text collision.
compact-dark/after.png and light-mark/after.png keep semantic value text readable while allowing subdued or colored marks.
world-light/after.png has broad pale empty field around a relatively small node and route cluster; labels are legible but visually underweighted.
Lower chart labels and footer relationship key remain small and close to the lower edge in compact after screenshots, although they are visible and not visibly clipped.
The local report’s lowest nominal ratio is approximately 4.5037:1; the screenshot is readable, but the margin is narrow.

recommendation: Contrast improvements are effective in the supplied latest renders. Keep near-threshold gray text and overview-scale density under regression review, and tighten world framing or provide a detail state for the sparse overview.
